projects.title: VS Energy Audit
projects.description:
This project was started at EarthHack DFW 2017 around the idea of allowing an individual to perform their own "Energy Audit" on their home and record changes in energy consumption (and cost) into a database. The resources for information on an Energy Audit come from https://energy.gov/energysaver/do-it-yourself-home-energy-audits

The main skills demonstrated in the project are:
 - Use of AngularJS to make a UI
 - API that connects to a DocumentDB database (C#)
      ~ Includes GET, POST, ...

projects.title: UTAustinX: UT.6.03x Embedded Systems - Shape the World
projects.description:
- Established connection between LaunchPad to an access point on a class server to develop a basic understanding of Internet of Things concepts

- Performed labs to develop an understanding of embedded systems utilizing TI Microcontrollers

- Created C functions using array data structures that collect/debug systems as well as perform input/output operations on the serial port
